visual.description: Race chart background at 30% opacity — two shrinkflation annotation overlays appear on the chart near 2009. Annotation 1: 'Häagen-Dazs: 16 → 14 oz' with a small ice cream container icon that shrinks. Annotation 2: 'Skippy: 18 → 16.3 oz' with a peanut butter jar icon showing the indent. Each annotation has an arrow pointing to its product's line on the chart. Price tag overlay: '$3.99' in JetBrains Mono stays static while the package visually shrinks. Callout box: 'BLS records this as a price increase per unit.'

notes: First major shrinkflation showcase. The chart pauses at 2009 and the annotations overlay ON TOP of the chart — keeping the race context visible. The shrink animations should be smooth springs (stiffness 80, damping 18). The $3.99 price tag is the psychological anchor — it should be prominent, JetBrains Mono 36px, Accent Cream. The 'deeper indent' for Skippy is a nice detail — if feasible, show a side-view jar silhouette with the bottom dimple growing. Annotations should stagger in: Häagen-Dazs first (10-frame stagger), then Skippy.
